records.bodyText:
I'm fed up with politicians lying/misleading us! 
 
Shame Hillsborough Law isn't already in place they'd all be prosecuted! 
 
Well the councillors and Ministers who lied and misled at least. 
 Please sign the petition below  and share (remember to confirm the email) to include MSPs and MPs!! 
 
Main points of the Hillsborough Law (Public Office (Accountability) Bill): 
Duty of candour and assistance — a legal obligation on public authorities and officials to act with honesty, transparency and frankness when engaging with inquiries, inquests and investigations.
New criminal offences — replacing the common law offence of misconduct in public office with two clearer STATUTORY offences, plus a new offence of misleading the public (intentional or reckless, on matters of significant public concern).
Ethical conduct framework — public authorities must adopt and publish codes of conduct and take active steps to make staff aware of them.
Non-means-tested legal aid — for bereaved families at inquests where a public authority is an interested person (England and Wales only; Scotland has not yet matched this, please write to MSPs).
Parity of representation — bereaved families can have legal representation at inquiries/investigations. 
Intelligence services — the duty of candour applies to individual intelligence employees without carve-outs (resolved July 2026).
Territorial scope — the duty of candour, ethical conduct, and the misleading-the-public and misconduct offences extend to Scotland, England, Wales and Northern Ireland. The legal aid and parity-of-arms provisions are England and Wales only.

AI data centres are being fast-tracked across the UK. We had no say.
 
 No public consultation. No environmental assessment. No transparency on water, energy, or emissions. 
 
 The government met 137* businesses to shape this policy.  It met zero environmental/campaign groups.
 We're asking for one thing: a UK-wide public consultation before any further expansion. 
 
  No more green lights without evidence.
 
 Sign: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/783905
 Share before the next one goes up (remember to confirm email sent)
Created by @Robert Pownall
*Zoned Out report by Spotlight on Corruption, published 27 October 2026

SSEN, the monopoly electricity transmission operator owned by SSE plc, has insisted that it must build its proposed new 400KV Kintore-Tealing OH and mega pylons to carry the high volt cables because  technical reasons prevent the upgrading of its existing 275kv OHL and pylon towers .
SSEN when  questioned at the recent public planning  inquiry did not explain those technical reasons. 
Question: Do the existing 275K route and towers have a dual purpose/ provide an additional income to SSE plc via its  subsidiary company NEOS Networks?
NEOS Networks delivers essential national infrastructure for NE Scotland's internet broadband - high capacity business connectivity. NEOS published  map shows its NE Scotland connectivity route remarkably  matching SSEN’s existing 275kv OHL route. 
UK Government Companies House records shows that in July 2026 NEOS changed its HQ business address from that of  its parent  SSE's Perth HQ addresss  Inveralmond House, Dunkeld Road, Perth to a new address in Glasgow....
https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.u...

MID HILL WIND FARM – PUBLIC UPDATE
 Tuesday 24th November
 Forman Hall, Roberton
 Doors open 6.30pm | Presentation 7pm
Invenergy plans 13 wind turbines, each 200 metres high – taller than Blackpool Tower – in the Borthwickwater and Teviot valleys.
Come along to find out what is planned, where we are in the process and how it could affect you. We'll cover the many objections raised so far – including from the Ministry of Defence, RSPB Scotland and the Council's own Landscape Architect – and explain how you can have your voice heard before the Council's planning committee considers the application in February.
Everyone welcome. Please share with friends and neighbours 
Borthwickwater Landscape Conservation Group
